purpose: Canonical shared Supabase migrations, configuration, generated types, and type-only consumer contract.
rules: Start with `./dev status` (JSON orientation); before finishing run `./dev check` (typecheck, npm test, version:check, the agent-docs check, provenance). What each feature does and the command that proves it: [features/README.md](features/README.md); how a schema change moves today, input for the owner's schema session and not a rule: [features/schema-change.md](features/schema-change.md).

Every commit ends with `Refs:` (OVE-n, B08-S<n>, D-<n>, AS-S<n>, ADR-NNNN) and, when they apply, `Decisions:` and `Docs:`; `./dev trace check` reports gaps, and the commit-msg hook (`./dev hooks install`) and CI warn only until the owner says block ([provenance](features/provenance.md)).
Commit each ordered migration and regenerated src/database.generated.ts together. This repository is the only migration and type authority; consumers pin the contract.
Schema batches follow the review workspace protocol: recommended, approved by John, then executed; no unapproved migration, version cut or grant change.
Preserve the populated shared database. Never bypass reset-disposable-local.mjs guards; fresh-chain proofs require a separate explicitly disposable project.

scripts/install-ai-engineer.mjs is the only release and fresh-install path; db:start, db:migrate and scripts/apply-disposable-migration.mjs are disposable development tools. The remote aieng-db is reached only through its --remote-reinstall and wipe gates, on John's explicit go.

Local by default: workspace:* read --db-url or a loopback AIENG_DB_LOCAL_DSN, and AIENG_DB_ADMIN_DSN only with --target remote; `./dev db` arrives with Mission Control's config/planes.toml. Never write the AI Engineer Aura graph 4773dc72.
Cloud type regeneration requires an explicit project identity. Deployment claims require current evidence (read the target's supabase_migrations.schema_migrations), not historical documentation.
workspace/ is generated by npm run workspace:build; edit workspace-enrichment/ or the generator, never the tree; CI fails on drift (workspace:check) or non-reproducible pages (workspace:validate).
Search explicit source paths first. Do not recursively enumerate artifacts, outputs, runs, receipts, caches, dependencies, or private notes.
